ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme and uncover the extent of the scheme, including the number of people involved and the amount of money stolen.
questions: How many people were involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. By following the money and investigating the scheme, we can gain a better understanding of how these schemes work and how to prevent them in the future.
